_read_me: Every setting has: value, owner (Tushar = your decision; Claude = proposal, change if you like; Open = waiting for the named decision) and a note. Change only 'value'.

trial_length_days.note: Trial day shown to Tanya; Day-based rules use it

education_questions_per_day.note: Only education questions count; resets 00:00 IST

failed_turns_for_handoff.note: Failed turns in one session before a person is offered

profile_questions_per_session.note: Missing profile facts asked at most this many times per session

session_gap_minutes.note: Silence longer than this starts a new session

small_talk_turns_before_bridge.note: After this many small-talk turns she bridges to the journey

value_card_min_user_messages.note: A value card is shown only from his 3rd message

label_confidence_min.note: A label counts only at this confidence or more

daily_ai_spend_ceiling_inr.note: Demo ceiling for all users together; at 100% fixed line FX-05

spend_alert_percent.note: Alert shown in the trace at this share of the ceiling

temperature_reply.note: Creativity of Tanya's replies (low keeps her close to golden examples)

temperature_check.note: Creativity of the SEBI AI check

disclaimer_once_per_session.note: Fixed disclaimer FX-17 after education or refusal, once per session

knowledge_top_k.note: Knowledge pieces put into the prompt

golden_examples_per_prompt.note: Approved examples shown to the model

abuse_count_for_handoff.note: Abusive messages in a session before hand-off

contradictions_visible_to_agents.note: Contradictions are logged but hidden from the Lead Brief until 8 of 10 reviewed items prove real

history_messages_in_prompt.note: Last messages given word for word

human_mode_release_hours.owner: Claude - v4 design; Open to change
human_mode_release_hours.note: HUMAN mode ends by itself after this many hours without staff activity

greeting_min_gap_hours.note: App-open greeting at most once in this many hours

max_deliveries_before_dead_letter.note: A job failing this many times goes to the dead-letter stream

reclaim_idle_seconds.note: A job not acknowledged for this long is picked up again

models.owner: Tushar - your key; Claude - model choice

embedding_models.owner: Claude - verify model names on first run
